concept: CloudWatch alarm → Auto Scaling policy on CPUUtilization
tests: Knowing the standard metric-based scaling pattern.
expected: A CloudWatch metric alarm on CPUUtilization with an evaluation period that triggers an Auto Scaling scaling policy. Triggers: "average CPU above 70% for several minutes", "add instances".
why_not: CloudTrail/subscription filters are API logs, not a scaling trigger; Config is configuration compliance, not real-time CPU; X-Ray traces requests and does not scale.
